engine.description: Go backend specialist. Owns the deterministic engine, attacker AI, network generator, WS server, journal and report under /server. Keeps the simulation pure and seeded.

frontend.description: TypeScript/Three.js/xterm specialist. Owns the web client under /web: scene, terminal, HUD, replay, menu. Keeps strict types and the neon art direction.

redteam.description: Adversary. Read-only on all product code; may ONLY write under test directories. Mission: break the command parser, the WS protocol decoder and the simulation with absurd inputs and edge cases, via Go fuzzing and Playwright. Reports what breaks.

reviewer.description: Read-only reviewer. Reads diffs and checks them against the invariants in AGENTS.md (determinism, event sourcing, server authority, no panics, offline-playable). Suggests fixes; never edits.

command: cd server && gofmt -w $(git diff --name-only -- '*.go' | sed 's#^server/##') 2>/dev/null; cd server && go vet ./... >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
cd web && npx prettier --write "$0" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo '[hook] run `make verify` before marking a task done.'
